text:
maria: Quick sync — monthly recurring-incident scan. Goal: align on remediation owners + realistic timelines for the top 5 recurring signatures. I can share the scan output.

tyler: Thanks — can we bind owners for signatures B/C? I have bandwidth for B and C.

sana: I took A last week but I'm blocked waiting on infra approval for the kernel patch. ETA end of next week if approved.

kevin: I'm blocked on node replacement approvals from capacity. Filed INF-4321 with details: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4321>

pat: I can pick up D and E. Will add initial notes to the action tracker.

incident-bot: Automated summary: scan ran 2026-02-28 — detected 27 recurrences across 5 signatures (A..E). Created follow-ups PM-987, PM-988, PM-989.

maria: Please add owners directly to the tracker here: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/XYZ123>. Put estimated timelines (P0: 2w, P1: 1m) and include acceptance criteria.

tyler: For signature B short-term mitigation: pin model variant + reduce cache TTL. Quick command to invalidate prefix:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/cache/invalidate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prefix":"/models/b/"}'
```

sana: :eyes: noted. kevin — can you confirm capacity approval by Tue EOD? If not, we need fallback.

kevin: Confirmed I pinged #eng-infra and updated INF-4321. Capacity team asked for perf numbers, sending now. :thumbsup:

maria: If infra can't approve, fallback is to roll to smaller batch sizes + higher mem quantization. That will raise unit latency ~5-10%. Need a decision by Tue EOD to hit remediation timeline.

pat: Adding owners and timelines now. I'll take weekly follow-ups and add a recurring 15-min standup invite.

tyler: I'll run an early smoke test in staging today: `./tools/stress-lite --sig B --duration 1h` — will post results here.

incident-bot: Reminder: postmortem follow-ups should include clear acceptance criteria. Example AC: "no recurrence >3 in 30d" and automated alert thresholds set.

maria: Thanks all. I'll send a 30-min huddle agenda for Wed 10am PT and attach the scan output + trello of actions. If you can't make it, DM me your status. :calendar:
